edition: Rahlfs–Hanhart 2006; German Bible Society online running text
authorization: User authorized provisional continuation with Rahlfs–Hanhart; Göttingen not obtained.
scope: Rahlfs–Hanhart 2006 remains the user-authorized provisional base. Focused checks of the publisher’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not a complete critical-text or apparatus verification. Göttingen, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.
historical_records: Existing index and reference records were consulted as historical reference, not proof of fresh complete Greek verification.

chapters.english_review: Every existing reading unit individually read; English clarity, cadence and consistency reviewed.
chapters.running_text_read: Selected verses only; not a complete Greek collation.
chapters.decision: Modernized ordinary address in the festival instructions. Preserved Thy/Thou in the prayer and made the accompanying direct-address verb forms consistent: dost preserve and didst choose/sanctify. Retained repeated Lord and priest expressions, the thick-water account, narrative first-person shift, divine titles, and Nephthar/Nephthai distinction.
chapters.pending: Prayer-title syntax at 1:24–25, the battle clause at 1:11, the narrative voice at 1:20, Jonathan/Nehemiah syntax at 1:23, flame/light relation at 1:32, and complete critical collation.
